info.title: API.SH: Mercari
info.description: The Mercari API from API.SH: public Mercari data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Mercari's full category tree (id, name, parent, children) for the US or Japan site: the ids `category_id` takes in search.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/mercari-categories

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Mercari listing: name, price (and original price), status, full description, all photos, condition, brand, size, color, category path, shipping (who pays, from where, method, fee, days), likes, the seller (name, rating, reviews, sales, items listed, verified, joined) and `raw`. Japan items also carry the comments, attributes and hashtags; Mercari Shops products (Japan) carry the shop with its score and other items.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/mercari-item

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The item id (m followed by digits; a Mercari Shops product id for JP) or an item link from mercari.com or jp.mercari.com.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: US (default) or JP. A link picks the country itself.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

item.name: Nintendo Switch
item.description: Nintendo Switch. Good condition, missing kickstand. Works great. Comes with what is pictured.

get.description:
Reviews a jp.mercari.com user received, newest first: rating (good, normal, bad), message, reviewer, date, plus the rating summary. Filter by rating, or read the reviews they received as a buyer. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; it is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/mercari-reviews

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The jp.mercari.com user id or profile link.

parameters.name: as
parameters.description: seller (default): reviews from buyers; buyer: reviews from sellers.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

reviews.message: この度はお取引ありがとうございました。また機会がありましたらよろしくお願いします。

get.description:
Search Mercari listings in the US (mercari.com, default) or Japan (jp.mercari.com) with the site's filters: sort, sale status, price range, condition, category, brand, shipping, color and size. Each item has id, name, price and currency, status, condition, brand, category, photos, seller id, link and `raw` (the site's record). `total` is the site's result count. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; it is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/mercari-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words (optional when category_id or brand_id is given).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: US (default, mercari.com) or JP (jp.mercari.com; prices in JPY).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), newest, price_asc, price_desc, likes (JP only; US falls back to relevance).

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Lowest price (USD for US, JPY for JP).

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Highest price (USD for US, JPY for JP).

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: Comma-separated: new, like_new, good, fair, poor (JP also bad).

parameters.name: brand_id
parameters.description: Brand ids, comma-separated (from `brand_id` / `brand.id` of an item).

parameters.name: exclude
parameters.description: Words the results must not contain.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page (default 30, max 100 US / 120 JP).

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: JP only: ja (default) or en for condition, shipping and category names.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A Mercari seller's public profile: name, photo, introduction, rating and review count (JP: good/normal/bad counts), sales, items listed, followers and following, verification badges, US shipping and response badges and cancellation rate, join date and `raw`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/mercari-seller

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The seller id (digits) or a profile link (mercari.com/u/<id>, jp.mercari.com/user/profile/<id>).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: US (default) or JP. A link picks the country itself.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A seller's listings, newest first by default, with the same filters and item fields as search (status, sort, price, condition, category, brand). Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; it is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/mercari-seller-items

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The seller id (digits) or a profile link.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words inside the seller's listings.

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: Comma-separated: new, like_new, good, fair, poor.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The items mercari.com shows as similar to a listing: name, price, original price, condition, brand, category, photos, likes, seller id and link.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/mercari-similar

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The mercari.com item id or link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
